transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I keep misplacing order tickets and other important paperwork at my dry-cleaning shop, and it’s starting to seriously hurt my business. Ever since I took over running the shop myself a couple of years ago, these organization struggles have gotten so much worse and I'm just feeling really overwhelmed.
Looking back at your childhood or school years, do you remember struggling with organization, forgetfulness, or staying focused on tasks even before you took over the shop?

Yes, absolutely. Even back in elementary school, my teachers would write on my report cards that I was always chatting, getting out of my seat, and losing my worksheets. I've had milder versions of these struggles my whole life, but they've just become so much harder to manage since I took over running the shop.
Do you often find yourself feeling restless, like you have an internal motor that keeps you going, or do you frequently interrupt others when they are speaking?

Yes, I definitely feel that restlessness—during long church meetings or when I'm doing computer work, I constantly have to pop up from my chair to check on things because I just can't sit still. I also struggle with interrupting, often butting into conversations at the shop or jumping in to finish people's sentences before they can even finish speaking.
